page: Vultr voc-s-24c-192gb-5760s-amd is an Optimized Cloud Compute server featuring 24 dedicated vCPUs powered by an AMD EPYC processor running at 2.0 GHz. Built on the x86_64 architecture, this instance provides 12 physical cores with 2 threads per core. It is equipped with 192.0 GB of system memory, yielding 8.0 GB of RAM per core, and includes 5760 GB of local NVMe SSD storage. The CPU features 16 MB of L3 cache, 0.5 MB of L2 cache, and 32 KB of L1d cache, alongside hardware support for AVX, AES, SHA_NI, and BMI2 instructions.

In benchmark evaluations, the server demonstrates strong CPU capabilities, with stress-ng single-core and multi-core performance ranking in the top 25%. Passmark CPU tests confirm this strength, scoring 51579.99 overall and showing robust results in physics and extended instruction sets. Large-block memory bandwidth is a notable highlight, with read speeds of 467.73 GB/sec and write speeds of 282.99 GB/sec both placing in the top 10% tier. Meanwhile, database operations, static web serving at 20.63 GB/sec, and Redis SET operations at 51.19 million operations per second perform within average parameters.

This server offers high resource density, balancing a generous memory-to-core ratio with substantial local NVMe storage. The lack of GPU acceleration makes it unsuitable for heavy graphics or large-scale deep learning training, though it handles smaller LLM inference tasks adequately, achieving 27.11 tokens per second on a 7B model. The combination of dedicated AMD EPYC compute cores, high-capacity memory, and fast local storage makes this instance highly efficient for memory-intensive databases, large-scale data processing, and enterprise web applications.
